protocol.independent_unit: paired evaluation group for the equal-group estimand; detector checkpoint within training-run cluster for hierarchical summaries
protocol.primary_summary: paired group-level AP50 difference, with each evaluation group weighted equally within a dataset
protocol.secondary_endpoint: single dataset-balanced CS-ECF-minus-CDF contrast; per-dataset breakdowns are descriptive
protocol.inference_scope: Checkpoint contrasts are reported descriptively because they share test groups and some training-run structure. DroneVehicle uses three fixed 100-frame blocks from one training run.
protocol.oracle: candidate with maximum per-image AP50 selected with test labels; upper bound only

oracle.method: per-image AP50 maximum over vis/CDF/PIA/SPG; ties to visible

cdf_comparison.role: single prespecified secondary estimand; per-dataset descriptive

validation_policy_grid.selection_note: The four-candidate top-five rule was fixed before margin selection. Among the pre-specified margin grid, 1.5 was the first setting satisfying the 0.0005 per-evaluator loss bound and the largest balanced validation gain under that rule.

K5_m1.5.estimand: equal-group point estimates; tested only for the frozen policy

baselines.estimand_note: Control rows retain pooled-checkpoint calculations. They are descriptive and are not used as matched evidence for the equal-group primary contrast.

equal_group_source.point_and_interval_scope: The point, primary interval, and stability audit use the same equal-group estimand. Pooled AP50 and AP50-95 values are descriptive and are not the target of the interval.

csecf_minus_visible.description: Descriptive pooled-checkpoint AP50-95 difference; no interval or confirmatory inference.
